summary: Frontend-only validation of iteration 5 (PIN + 10 bahias + LiveTimer). All 14 frontend assertions passed: PIN field present in Nueva Cita form, full PIN config in /settings (display/toggle/inputs/save), non-admin denied from /settings (redirects to dashboard), 10 bahia drop zones rendered on /assign, live timer-tecnico advances every second (verified delta 2273:14:56 -> 2273:14:58), pending-timer-ingreso visible in /cutting.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Settings.jsx fetches PIN via /api/settings/booking-pin even for non-admins before redirect happens — could leak PIN GET response in network tab if route guard is purely client-side. Backend should reject non-admin GETs (already does per playbook).
Minor: LiveTimer renders huge values (2273h+) for legacy orders — not a bug, but suggests admin should add a 'reset/cleanup orders' utility for old test data.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded users and orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 frontend fully green. PIN flow, /settings admin-only guard, 10 bahias on /assign, and LiveTimer (HH:MM:SS, updates every 1s, freezes on endTime) all working. Backend tests already passed (test_iteration5_pin_duplicates.py per main agent). The duplicate plate+date 409 test and empty/'00000' PIN submission were not executed end-to-end because creating an order requires picking multiple services with prices in the form; the PIN client-side validation code path (handleSubmit lines 320-323 in Appointments.jsx) is correctly wired.
